items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: "They say, 'Brubeck wrote it — Green wrote the tune, Coleman Hawkins just played it.'"

ctx.x: But so I said, “Man, you know something? Y’all don’t know nothing about music” you know. They said, “Who do you think you are, a little Negro from St. Augustine, Florida you know. You don’t know diddly.” I said, “I might not but I know about music. You all don’t know nothing about music” you know then I bowed my head and backed off you know. But you know that’s the thing, you know so, but then yeah, I realized you improvised but actually Gary Bartz taught me this, you’re not really improvising, you’re a composer…
Right. You’re not getting any writer’s credit for the improvising.
